event_properties.content: Based on the available data, I can see complaint counts across outlets, but there's no week-over-week or month-over-month comparison to identify which location has *rising* complaints. The current snapshot shows **Tadigadapa** (rank 10) and **Bhavanipuram** (rank 5 and 12) have the highest complaint volumes, but I'd need historical data to confirm if complaints are actually increasing at these locations.
